name: iReal comp stabs
desc: Harvested square-wave comping through ireal voice-led changes in D dorian: Charleston-style struct, double-time comp bars every phrase, slow filter drift.

code.full: chord("<Dm9 G13 Em7 A7>").dict('ireal').voicing().struct("[~ x] [x ~] [~ x] [~ [x ~]]").s("square").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.2).slow(24)).attack(.005).decay(.3).sustain(.12).release(.1).gain(${gain}).room(${room}).every(8, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: chord("<Dm9 G13 Em7 A7 Dm9 G13 Fmaj7 E7>").dict('ireal').voicing().struct("[x x] [~ x] [x ~] [x [x x]]").s("square").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.85, ${cut}*1.4).slow(12)).attack(.004).decay(.26).sustain(.14).release(.08).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.6, ${gain}).fast(2)).room(${room}).every(4, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(4).play()
